files.purpose: DOM-free helpers: system preference reading and watching, reduced-motion resolution, bounded accessibility prefs, root data attributes, keyboard chord matching and the Alt+digit view shortcut mapping.

Visible focus ring for controls (zero-specificity :where), reduced motion from the OS query and from the in-app data-motion attribute, and forced-colors state rules that use system color keywords only.

21 behavior tests. Bundles the real TypeScript with esbuild and calls it with fake matchMedia, dataset and key-event objects. Parses the stylesheet for validity, focus safety, reduced-motion scope and system-only colors.

checks.note: Existing lockfile dependencies only. No global installs.
Covers src/ui/accessibility.ts because tsconfig includes src.
Whole suite in this worktree. Not a result for this module alone.
Changing the Alt+0 mapping fails 3 tests. Changing the forced-colors outline to a named color fails the system-color test. Restored files pass again.

exports.readSystemPreferences: (matchMedia | undefined) => { reducedMotion: boolean; forcedColors: boolean }. Missing matchMedia reads as false.
exports.watchSystemPreferences: (matchMedia | undefined, onChange(prefs)) => cleanup(). Without matchMedia it is a no-op.
exports.resolveReducedMotion: (systemReduced, appReduced) => boolean. Either source wins. Only literal true counts.
exports.normalizeAccessibilityPrefs: (raw: unknown) => { reduceMotion: boolean }. Use for the in-app setting.
exports.applyAccessibilityAttributes: (rootElement, state) => void. Sets data-motion='reduced'|'full' and data-forced-colors='active'|'none'.
exports.parseChord: (chord: string) => Chord | null. Modifiers Alt, Ctrl/Control, Shift, Meta/Win.
exports.matchesChord: (chord: string, keyEvent) => boolean. Exact key and exact modifier set.
exports.viewShortcut: (position) => 'Alt+n' | null. Null outside 1..10, so Alt+11 is never shown.
exports.viewPositionFromEvent: (keyEvent, viewCount = 10) => position | null. Alt plus a digit only, with no other modifiers, and within viewCount.

captain_wiring: main.tsx: import './styles/accessibility.css' after responsive.css so it loads last.

App.tsx useReducedMotion / useThemeSync: replace the local OS query with watchSystemPreferences + resolveAccessibilityState + applyAccessibilityAttributes. The result should set data-motion exactly as before.
App.tsx Shell keydown and nav labels: use viewPositionFromEvent(e, VIEWS.length) and viewShortcut(idx) instead of inline Alt logic. This also removes the Alt+11 label on Developer (K10).
Any JS-driven animation (for example the Motion Studio canvas loop) must read the resolved reduceMotion flag itself. The CSS rules cannot stop requestAnimationFrame.

browser_apis_used_at_runtime: window.matchMedia (passed in by the caller, optional)

limitations: Nothing was rendered. Forced colors, reduced motion and focus rules are checked by parsing the stylesheet and by the TypeScript behavior tests, not in Electron or Windows High Contrast. A runtime check is still needed before any accessibility claim.
No real desktop input, screen reader or Narrator run was done. Focus order and announcements remain unverified.

The forced-colors rules cover the state markers the components already emit (aria-current, aria-selected, aria-checked, aria-pressed, disabled). Components that show state only with background color and no ARIA marker are not covered.
Reduced motion shortens durations to 0.01ms rather than removing them. Spinners stop after one iteration, so any busy indicator also needs text.
prefers-contrast is not handled. It was left out to keep the module small.
The in-app App.tsx reduce-motion logic is not changed here. The captain or shell owner must switch it over, as listed in captain_wiring.
The brief's phrase 'Small8/64' was ambiguous, so no 8 or 64 size bounds were added. The bounded helpers are the prefs normalizer and the view-position limit.
No skill files were read. None were explicitly assigned to this worker.
Shell wiring, the Developer shortcut list and the App.tsx changes belong to other owners. This module is not imported by any existing file yet.
